ms.gen.nojs: The form needs JavaScript. The script below is the default one: the router pulls the agent from Docker Hub.
ms.gen.remoteImage.hint: The router pulls it and picks its own architecture. Nothing is uploaded.
ms.gen.arch.hint: Picks the tar to download. The script is the same for every architecture.
ms.gen.disk.name: Disk name
ms.gen.disk.hint: A RAM disk is lost on reboot, so start on boot turns off.
ms.gen.disk.tmpfsFirst: Create the RAM disk first; uninstall leaves it:
ms.gen.name: Install name
ms.gen.name.hint: Names the envlist, the tag and the root. A second install needs its own.
ms.gen.veth.hint: A name no interface on the router has.
ms.gen.subnet.ends: A /30 at its network address: router {router}, agent {agent}.
ms.gen.ifaceList.hint: The list a drop rule's in-interface-list=! names. none joins no list.
ms.gen.addrList.hint: The list a drop rule's src-address-list=! names. none joins no list.
ms.gen.ifaceList.name: Interface list name
ms.gen.addrList.name: Address list name
ms.gen.bufferS.hint: How long the collector can be away without losing samples, 10–3600.
ms.gen.memLimitMB.hint: Empty: derived from the ring, {n} MiB now. Else 8–1024.
ms.gen.triggers.hint: The agent default is softnet-drop, oom, kmsg<=3, reset, irq-err and flash-bad.
ms.gen.privileged.hint: Off, the agent cannot read kmsg, slabinfo, pagetypeinfo or the flash (MTD) counters.
ms.gen.token.hint: 32 random characters made in this page; nothing is sent or stored. Every endpoint but /healthz then asks for it.
ms.gen.expose: Expose the agent on the router's LAN address
ms.gen.expose.hint: Adds a dst-nat rule and a forward accept rule. Needs a token.
ms.gen.lanAddress.hint: An IPv4 address the router has on the LAN.
ms.gen.startOnBoot.hint: Whether RouterOS starts the container after a reboot.
ms.gen.extractTimeout.hint: Tar only: how long the script waits for the extraction before it deletes the tar, 10s to 600s.
ms.gen.out.cli: The same script from the CLI
ms.gen.out.tar: Fetch, check and upload the tar
ms.gen.cli.tokenEnv: The command reads the token from {env}: export it first.
ms.gen.copyFailed: Copy failed: select the text and copy it by hand.
ms.gen.tokenWarning: This script contains the token in clear: treat it as a credential.
ms.gen.summary: {n} settings need a fix. The script appears when every setting is valid.
ms.gen.summaryOne: 1 setting needs a fix. The script appears when every setting is valid.
ms.gen.invalidHere: Fix the settings in the form to see these commands.
ms.gen.tar.notNeeded: A registry pull uploads nothing: skip this step.
ms.gen.verify.lan: From a computer on the LAN
ms.gen.err.pattern.name: 1 to 32 characters: letters, digits, _ . -, starting with a letter or a digit.
ms.gen.err.pattern.objectName: 1 to 64 characters: letters, digits, _ . -, starting with a letter or a digit.
ms.gen.err.pattern.disk: A disk name from /disk: letters, digits, _ -, like usb1.
ms.gen.err.pattern.memory: Digits and an optional K, M or G, like 64M.
ms.gen.err.pattern.duration: Digits and s, m or h, like 10s.
ms.gen.err.pattern.imageRef: A lowercase registry reference, like ghcr.io/owner/name:1.0.0.
ms.gen.err.builtinList: {list} is a RouterOS built-in list, which takes no member. Name your firewall's list, or pick none.
ms.gen.err.lanAddress: Enter the router's IPv4 LAN address.
ms.gen.err.exposeToken: Exposing the agent needs a token: generate one.
ms.gen.err.memLimitDerived: The derived limit, {got} MiB, is outside {min}–{max}: lower the rate or the ring, raise the container memory, or set the limit.
ms.gen.err.triggerUnknown: {trigger} is not a condition the agent knows.
ms.gen.err.triggerRange: {trigger}: the threshold must be a number from {min} to {max}.
ms.gen.err.triggersEmpty: Choose at least one condition, or use the agent default. A capture budget of 0 turns capture off.
